usageNotes: Use this to update the CIDR value, comment, or name of an existing firewall alias on a specific LXC container. Requires VM.Config.Network on the container's vmid path; the alias must already exist (create with the POST variant first). Pass the current configuration digest to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Update an alias CIDR and rename it on an LXC container

params.comment: Updated management network after subnet expansion

tips: The alias name must start with a letter and match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+; purely numeric names are rejected.
Renaming an alias via the 'rename' param updates any firewall rules that reference it by name automatically within the same container scope.
This endpoint returns null on success — treat any non-error HTTP 200 response as confirmation.
Fetch the current digest from the GET alias endpoint and include it to prevent a lost-update race condition in automated workflows.
